issues.explanation: Current claim states carrier ready at 10点, but evidence at the same time shows valve cap not locked, violating readiness rule.

evidence.excerpt: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier gauge read four bars, but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute.
A North Glass pneumatic carrier is ready for dispatch only when its pressure gauge reads four bars and its valve cap is locked.

issues.reasoning: Span 5 shows at 10点 the carrier gauge read four bars but its valve cap remained loose and not locked throughout that minute. Span 4 defines ready as requiring four bars and a locked valve cap. Both are anchored to the same 10点, so the carrier could not be ready; the draft claim directly conflicts.

suggested_revision.before: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was ready for dispatch.
suggested_revision.after: At 10点 on the same day, the North Glass pneumatic carrier was not ready for dispatch because its valve cap remained loose and not locked.
